## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Explain the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one. / 说明使用者遇到的问题和修改后的行为；如有相关问题单，请附链接。

## Validation / 验证

Describe the relevant checks and their results. For documentation changes, check links and examples. / 说明相关检查及结果；文档修改核对链接和示例即可。

## Documentation / 文档

Note any configuration, output-contract or English/Chinese documentation updates. / 说明配置、输出合同及中英文文档的对应修改。

Do not include credentials, private media/transcripts or model weights. / 不提交凭据、私密媒体/文字稿和模型权重。
